comment: MCP-M3-03's spend check vectors: each case's state (P's pin and retained chains, whether it is known forked, identity keys, approval-capable devices, presence key rows as stored and the governing rule), its Signed ApprovalDecisions and CanonicalAction as stored, the spender, the verifier's time in ms, whether a use is reserved, whether it is judged as a k-approver set, and the SpendRefusalCode it ends in, empty when it spends. Synthetic keys from fixed seeds; signatures are deterministic. go test -run TestSpendVectors -update-spend-vectors rewrites this file.
